component.name: ByteSweeper
component.summary: Clear digital sectors and outsmart hidden glitches

description.p: ByteSweeper is a fast-paced, modern twist on classic grid-sweeping puzzles built natively for the Linux desktop. Navigate five escalating digital sectors, deduce where glitches are hiding, and use tactical power-ups when pure logic hits a wall.

ul.li: Five progressive sectors from 6×6 Boot Cache to 12×12 Core Matrix
Shield system that lets you survive accidental glitch hits
Tactical Patch and Radar Scan abilities powered by collected Energy
Warp Nodes that teleport your scan across the board
Full mouse and keyboard navigation (Arrows, WASD, or Vim keys)

description.p: Initial release featuring 5 sectors, tactical power-ups, synthesized retro audio, and keyboard controls.
